start: A phone or laptop with no gym signed in; the address app.mettleup.fit/demo

user_sees: Orange strip at the top: "Demo gym: made-up data. Nothing you do here is saved."
Button "Leave the demo"
The Today screen of the sample gym with its name
must_not: A sign-in or set-up screen
A real gym of this device opens
A call to the gym server

steps.action: Open the menu and move between screens
user_sees: The same sample gym name on every screen
The strip stays on top
must_not: The strip scrolls away or hides a header
An empty gym with no members

start: A device already signed in to a real gym; the address app.mettleup.fit/demo

user_sees: "Demo gym: made-up data. Nothing you do here is saved."
Button "Back to my gym"
The sample gym, not the signed-in gym
must_not: The real gym name, members or join code anywhere
The real gym is signed out

user_sees: A full page load into the real gym, still signed in
must_not: The sample members show inside the real gym
A sign-in screen

start: The address app.mettleup.fit/demo?as=desk (the front desk kind of the demo)

user_sees: The same strip and sample gym
The signed-in person is the front desk person Sunita, not the owner Vikram
must_not: Owner-only screens work as for the owner
The owner name shows as "You"

user_sees: The menu also has "Workout offer" as its own line (desk only)
must_not: A blank menu
An error about the gym not being online

start: Demo gym open as the owner; a screen that needs a real gym

steps.action: Open Settings > Branding from the menu
user_sees: Page title "Branding"
Card "This works in your own gym"
Body ends "The demo gym is made-up data kept only on this page, so this part is switched off here."
Button "Back to Today"
must_not: A logo upload form that seems to work
An endless spinner
A raw error such as "Could not find the function"

user_sees: The Today screen of the sample gym
must_not: Leaving the demo

start: Demo gym open; the prospect has changed something (for example answered a member question)

user_sees: The sample gym starts over: the change is gone
"Demo gym: made-up data. Nothing you do here is saved." still on top
must_not: The change kept after the refresh
Anything written into the browser storage for the demo

user_sees: The landing page gyms.mettleup.fit
must_not: A gym is created or signed in on this device

start: A device signed in to a real gym with real members; demo opened in the same browser

steps.action: Open app.mettleup.fit/demo and look at Members, Today and Settings > Staff & sign-in
user_sees: Only made-up people and numbers of the sample gym
must_not: A real member name, phone number or payment
The real join code or sign-in key
A request leaving the page to the gym server

steps.action: Do a change (reply to a message), then tap "Back to my gym"
user_sees: The real gym exactly as it was
must_not: The real gym changed by what was done in the demo
